name: usage-torch
description: Your Claude usage limit, as a one-line torch bar above the prompt that fades as you use it.

tiredBelowPercent.title: Tired below (% left)
tiredBelowPercent.description: The bar turns low when less than this share of the limit is left.

sleepAtPercentUsed.title: Sleep at (% used)
sleepAtPercentUsed.description: The flame goes out once this share of the limit is used.
